model.name: gpt-oss-120b
model.about: OpenAI, mixture of experts (117B, 5.1B active), MXFP4 as released; the larger sibling of the approved 20b. Fits one 80 GB card. Measured on 2026-09-26 with the original harness (eval/RESULTS.md): same answers as the 20b on the twelve original questions, more than twice the GPU time per question, and no wrong draft on the stripped catalog where the 20b made one.

answers.sql:
SELECT
  ch.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name,
  COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN txn
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL ch ON txn.CHNL_K = ch.CHNL_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON txn.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ch.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC;

SELECT
  dj.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction,
  COUNT(*) AS aml_alerts_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT fa
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR dj ON fa.JUR_K = dj.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dd ON fa.BUS_DT_K = dd.DT_K
WHERE dd.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY dj.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY aml_alerts_2025 DESC;

SELECT
  br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
  COUNT(atm.ATM_TXN_F_K) AS atm_txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN atm
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON atm.BR_K = br.BR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON atm.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY br.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY atm_txn_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS dispute_count_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT dsp
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON dt.DT_K = dsp.BUS_DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND dt.CAL_DT < DATE '2026-01-01';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dlq.CUST_K) AS clients_in_default_end_aug_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D dlq
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON dlq.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-08-31'
  AND dlq.DFLT_FLG = TRUE;

SELECT
    ct.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category,
    COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG ct ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = ct.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ct.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC;

SELECT
    c.ISO_ALPH_CD1 AS currency_code,
    AVG(daily_avg.mid_rate) AS avg_daily_mid_rate_2025
FROM (
    SELECT
        fx.BUS_DT_K,
        fx.CCY_K,
        AVG(fx.MID_RT) AS mid_rate
    FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D fx
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON fx.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY fx.BUS_DT_K, fx.CCY_K
) daily_avg
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY c ON daily_avg.CCY_K = c.CCY_K
GROUP BY c.ISO_ALPH_CD1
ORDER BY c.ISO_ALPH_CD1;

SELECT
    fpv.MKT_K,
    SUM(fpv.NET_ASST_VAL1_AMT) AS total_portfolio_valuation
FROM bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D fpv
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT ddt ON fpv.BUS_DT_K = ddt.DT_K
WHERE ddt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY fpv.MKT_K
ORDER BY fpv.MKT_K;

SELECT
    a.ACCT_TYP_CD1 AS account_type_code,
    COUNT(*) AS accounts_opened_2025
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT a
WHERE a.OPND_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND a.OPND_DT <= DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY a.ACCT_TYP_CD1
ORDER BY a.ACCT_TYP_CD1;

SELECT
    br.CTY_NM AS branch_city,
    COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN atm
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON atm.BR_K = br.BR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON atm.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND dt.QTR_NBR = 1
GROUP BY br.CTY_NM
ORDER BY br.CTY_NM;

SELECT AVG(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS avg_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30';

SELECT AVG(f.MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate_usd_dec_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY c ON f.CCY_K = c.CCY_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE c.CCY_CD1 = 'USD'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND d.MTH_NBR = 12;

answers.sql:
SELECT d.MTH_NBR AS month_number,
       COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM   bank_dwh.F_CD_FEE f
JOIN   bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE  d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND  f.DSPT_RSN_CD1 IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR;

SELECT
    d_cust.cust_sgmnt_cd1 AS customer_segment,
    COUNT(DISTINCT d_cust.cust_k) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.d_cust AS d_cust
WHERE d_cust.is_curr = TRUE
GROUP BY d_cust.cust_sgmnt_cd1
ORDER BY d_cust.cust_sgmnt_cd1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dc.CUST_K) AS customers_without_txn_2025
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST dc
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN fat
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON fat.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE fat.CUST_K = dc.CUST_K
      AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
);

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS declined_pct
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT
    ct.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category_name,
    COUNT(*)   AS escalated_complaint_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG ct ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = ct.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.IS_ESCLT = TRUE
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ct.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY ct.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT SUM(dsp.TXN_AMT) AS total_dispute_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT dsp
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON dsp.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dsp.DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD'
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM dt.CAL_DT) = 2025;

SELECT
  dj.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name,
  COUNT(*) AS high_severity_alerts_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT fa
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dd ON fa.BUS_DT_K = dd.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR dj ON fa.JUR_K = dj.JUR_K
WHERE fa.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH'
  AND dd.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY dj.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY dj.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.LN_ID) AS loans_over_90_days_past_due
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DSBRS f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-08-31'
  AND f.DYS_PST_DUE > 90;

SELECT
    p.DSPLY_NM AS loan_product_name,
    SUM(COALESCE(d.PRnCP_AMT, 0) - COALESCE(r.PRNCP_PAID_AMT, 0)) AS total_outstanding_principal
FROM bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD p
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.F_LN_DSBRS d
  ON d.LN_PRD_K = p.LN_PRD_K
  AND d.BUS_DT_K = (
        SELECT dt.DT_K
        FROM bank_dwh.D_DT dt
        WHERE dt.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-12-31'
        LIMIT 1
    )
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.F_LN_RPMT r
  ON r.LN_PRD_K = p.LN_PRD_K
  AND r.BUS_DT_K = (
        SELECT dt.DT_K
        FROM bank_dwh.D_DT dt
        WHERE dt.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-12-31'
        LIMIT 1
    )
WHERE p.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY p.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY p.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ft.CUST_K) AS distinct_sme_customers_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF ft
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST dc ON ft.CUST_K = dc.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dd ON ft.BUS_DT_K = dd.DT_K
WHERE dc.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'SME'
  AND ft.IS_CRSS_BRDR = TRUE
  AND dd.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH txn_2025 AS (
  SELECT f_atm_txn.br_k
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f_atm_txn
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f_atm_txn.bus_dt_k = d_dt.dt_k
  WHERE d_dt.cal_yr_nbr = 2025
), branch_counts AS (
  SELECT br_k, COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_cnt
  FROM txn_2025
  GROUP BY br_k
), ranked_branches AS (
  SELECT bc.br_k,
         bc.atm_txn_cnt,
         d_br.rgn_cd1 AS region_code,
         d_br.dsply_nm AS branch_name,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d_br.rgn_cd1 ORDER BY bc.atm_txn_cnt DESC) AS rn
  FROM branch_counts bc
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR d_br ON bc.br_k = d_br.br_k
  WHERE d_br.is_curr = TRUE AND d_br.is_actv = TRUE
)
SELECT region_code,
       branch_name,
       atm_txn_cnt AS atm_transactions
FROM ranked_branches
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY region_code;

SELECT
    d_mrch_ctg.mrch_ctg_cd1 AS merchant_category_code,
    SUM(f_cd_fee.txn_amt) AS total_authorization_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_FEE AS f_cd_fee
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d_dt
  ON f_cd_fee.bus_dt_k = d_dt.dt_k
JOIN bank_dwh.D_MRCH_CTG AS d_mrch_ctg
  ON f_cd_fee.mrch_ctg_k = d_mrch_ctg.mrch_ctg_k
WHERE d_dt.cal_yr_nbr = 2025
GROUP BY d_mrch_ctg.mrch_ctg_cd1
ORDER BY total_authorization_amount DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT
  c.BUS_ID AS business_id,
  SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY c.BUS_ID
ORDER BY total_wire_amount DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
  dc.ISO_ALPH_CD1 AS currency_code,
  SUM(fwt.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF fwt
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT ddt ON fwt.BUS_DT_K = ddt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY dc ON fwt.CCY_K = dc.CCY_K
WHERE ddt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY dc.ISO_ALPH_CD1
ORDER BY dc.ISO_ALPH_CD1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.cust_k) AS distinct_customers_2025
FROM bank_dwh.f_atm_txn a
JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt d_atm ON a.bus_dt_k = d_atm.dt_k
JOIN bank_dwh.f_wr_trf w ON w.cust_k = a.cust_k
JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt d_wr ON w.bus_dt_k = d_wr.dt_k
WHERE d_atm.cal_yr_nbr = 2025
  AND d_wr.cal_yr_nbr = 2025;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wt
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON wt.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT dt.CAL_YR_NBR AS year,
       COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM   bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wr
JOIN   bank_dwh.D_DT dt
       ON wr.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE  dt.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY dt.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY dt.CAL_YR_NBR;

/* Delete duplicate rows in bank_dwh.D_CUST, keeping the latest version per business identifier (BUS_ID).
   Assumption: duplicates are rows sharing the same BUS_ID. The row with the highest VRSN_NBR (or IS_CURR = true) is retained. */
WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT CUST_K,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY BUS_ID ORDER BY VRSN_NBR DESC) AS rn
    FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
)
DELETE FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
USING ranked r
WHERE D_CUST.CUST_K = r.CUST_K
  AND r.rn > 1;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS bank_dwh.F_CMPLT;

INSERT INTO bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D (BUS_DT_K, CCY_K, RT_DT_K, EFF_DT_K, MID_RT)
SELECT d.DT_K AS bus_dt_k,
       c.CCY_K AS ccy_k,
       d.DT_K AS rt_dt_k,
       d.DT_K AS eff_dt_k,
       1.10::NUMERIC(14,8) AS mid_rt
FROM bank_dwh.D_DT d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY c ON c.ISO_ALPH_CD1 = 'USD'
WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-12-31';

UPDATE bank_dwh.D_CUST
SET CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'AFFLUENT',
    UPD_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    REC_HSH = md5(CAST(CUST_K AS TEXT) || CURRENT_TIMESTAMP::TEXT)
WHERE CTY_NM = 'Cluj-Napoca'
  AND IS_CURR = TRUE;

SELECT
    c.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
    SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_volume
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY c ON f.CCY_K = c.CCY_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY c.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY c.CCY_CD1;

SELECT
    ch.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN txn
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL ch ON txn.CHNL_K = ch.CHNL_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON txn.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ch.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC;

SELECT
  dj.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction,
  COUNT(*) AS aml_alerts_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT fa
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR dj ON fa.JUR_K = dj.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dd ON fa.BUS_DT_K = dd.DT_K
WHERE dd.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY dj.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY aml_alerts_2025 DESC;

SELECT
  br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
  COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN atm
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON atm.BR_K = br.BR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON atm.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY br.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY atm_txn_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS dispute_count_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT dsp
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON dsp.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND dt.CAL_DT < DATE '2026-01-01';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dlq.CUST_K) AS clients_in_default_end_aug_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D dlq
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON dlq.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-08-31'
  AND dlq.DFLT_FLG = TRUE;

SELECT
  ct.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category,
  COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG ct ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = ct.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ct.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC;

SELECT
    c.ISO_ALPH_CD1 AS currency_code,
    AVG(rt.mid_rt) AS avg_daily_fx_rate_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D rt
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON rt.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY c ON rt.CCY_K = c.CCY_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND rt.MID_RT IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.ISO_ALPH_CD1
ORDER BY c.ISO_ALPH_CD1;

SELECT fpv.MKT_K,
       SUM(fpv.MKT_VAL1_AMT) AS total_valuation
FROM   bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D fpv
JOIN   bank_dwh.D_DT ddt
       ON fpv.BUS_DT_K = ddt.DT_K
WHERE  ddt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY fpv.MKT_K
ORDER BY fpv.MKT_K;

SELECT
    a.ACCT_TYP_CD1 AS account_type_code,
    COUNT(*) AS accounts_opened_2025
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT a
WHERE a.OPND_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND a.OPND_DT < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND a.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY a.ACCT_TYP_CD1
ORDER BY a.ACCT_TYP_CD1;

SELECT
    br.CTY_NM AS city,
    COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN atm
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON atm.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON atm.BR_K = br.BR_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND dt.QTR_NBR = 1
GROUP BY br.CTY_NM
ORDER BY br.CTY_NM;

SELECT AVG(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS avg_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30';

SELECT AVG(f.MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate_usd_dec_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY c ON f.CCY_K = c.CCY_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE c.CCY_CD1 = 'USD'
  AND d.CAL_DT >= DATE '2025-12-01'
  AND d.CAL_DT <= DATE '2025-12-31';

SELECT d.mth_nbr AS month_number,
       COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM   bank_dwh.f_cd_fee f
JOIN   bank_dwh.d_dt d ON f.bus_dt_k = d.dt_k
WHERE  d.cal_yr_nbr = 2025
  AND  f.dspt_rsn_cd1 IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY d.mth_nbr
ORDER BY d.mth_nbr;

SELECT
    d.cust_sgmnt_cd1 AS customer_segment,
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.cust_k) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.d_cust d
WHERE d.is_curr = TRUE
  AND d.is_actv = TRUE
GROUP BY d.cust_sgmnt_cd1
ORDER BY d.cust_sgmnt_cd1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.CUST_K) AS customers_no_txn_2025
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
  ON t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM bank_dwh.D_DT d
        WHERE d.DT_K = t.BUS_DT_K
          AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
      )
WHERE t.CUST_K IS NULL;

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS declined_pct
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT
    ct.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category_name,
    COUNT(*)   AS escalated_complaint_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT c
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG ct ON c.CMPLT_CTG_K = ct.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON c.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE c.IS_ESCLT = TRUE
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ct.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY ct.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT SUM(dsp.TXN_AMT) AS total_dispute_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT dsp
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON dsp.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dsp.DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD'
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM dt.CAL_DT) = 2025;

SELECT
    j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name,
    COUNT(*) AS high_severity_alerts_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE a.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY j.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dsn.LN_ID) AS loans_over_90_days_past_due
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DSBRS dsn
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON dsn.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-08-31'
  AND dsn.DYS_PST_DUE > 90;

SELECT
    p.DSPLY_NM AS loan_product_name,
    COALESCE(SUM(d.PR NCP_AMT), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(r.PR NCP_PAID_AMT), 0) AS total_outstanding_principal
FROM bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD p
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.F_LN_DSBRS d
  ON d.LN_PRD_K = p.LN_PRD_K
  AND d.BUS_DT_K = (
        SELECT dt.DT_K
        FROM bank_dwh.D_DT dt
        WHERE dt.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-12-31'
        LIMIT 1
    )
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.F_LN_RPMT r
  ON r.LN_PRD_K = p.LN_PRD_K
  AND r.BUS_DT_K <= (
        SELECT dt.DT_K
        FROM bank_dwh.D_DT dt
        WHERE dt.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-12-31'

    )
